title: XW-ENC-AFFINITY-1 (apex-mf6) L1b live: boot-time RESUME, same-model same-pin ciphertext retention — the unproven resume-load seam (mf6 OPORD L-cell L1b/A3, the second of the two case parts owed by the OPORD; L2/B2 + L2b + L3/A1 already authored). Fresh headless gpt-5.6-sol session (responses wire; the row's x-litellm-tags pin 'East US 2' is UNTOUCHED — the live-config premise was settled by the L3 wave live probe per the ENC-SOL-2TURN-PINNED title; an untagged sol row is a REPORT finding, not a case edit). config_patch carries ONLY the global [models] default_reasoning_effort='max' (O7 M-1 carrier-mint lesson: the session's wire effort resolves from the models-manager current effort, which seeds from that global and projects onto the row menu — a row-level reasoning_effort scalar is INERT on the wire). Turn 1 (a reasoning-forcing modular-exponentiation prompt, tool-free by instruction so the turn-request count stays deterministic) mints: the response's reasoning item carries encrypted_content and is mint-stamped STORE-SIDE (D1) with the sol row's pin. The middle step is a TRUE boot-time resume — the headless driver re-boots the binary with -m gpt-5.6-sol --resume <sid> (same model, same pin): the persisted chat_history.jsonl (mint-stamped ride) is loaded VERBATIM from disk; the in-session projector does NOT run on this path (the seam XW-RESUME-CROSSFAM flagged UNPROVEN, here in its same-boundary form). Turn 2's request then replays turn 1's ride through the SEND-TIME gate: pin Some(EU2) x mint Some(EU2) = RETAIN (conversation.rs enc_affinity_gate, conversation.rs:135-141) -> the encrypted_content CROSSES the resumed request. This is THE mf6 behavioral delta on the resume path: the retired D-ENC stripped encrypted_content unconditionally at every /responses send, so under pre-mf6 code this pin is ABSENT and REDs. Zero 400/503 by construction (same-boundary retention is the deterministic arm): any retry on a pinned row (sol model-request count >3) = a boundary error where none was possible = classification drift -> report-and-stop. The D1 mint disk round-trip is a SCORED artifact pin (chat_history.jsonl carries mint_tag): if the stamp is lost on persist/load the ride degrades to (Some, None) = Strip and the wire pin fails — the resume-load sub-seam is witnessed independently of the gate. Suite is cross-wire (the committed schema has no enc-affinity suite; the affinity semantics live in the pins).

steps.prompt: Find the remainder when 7^8432 is divided by 5557. Work it out by hand using modular exponentiation (repeated squaring), showing each step, without using any tools or code execution.

ndjson.label: BOTH TURNS COMPLETE: the resume re-boot succeeded and the post-resume turn did not die (a resume rejection or a turn error = regression beyond the documented surface -> report-and-stop).
POST-RESUME TURN: the second (resumed) turn completed with the exact terminal text.

wire.label: CONTROL (class harness): the main (oldest) request carries the session model — the harness always does; a miss is a harness failure, never vacuous.

L1b RETAIN-VIA-RESUME (the mf6 delta pin): the POST-RESUME request carries turn 1's reasoning ciphertext — D1 mint-stamped the ride with the pinned sol row's tag at store time, the resume load path carried the mint_tag through the disk round-trip, and the send-time gate (pin Some x mint Some, exact-string) = RETAIN. Absent = a D-ENC-style unconditional strip (pre-mf6 behavior), a mint_tag lost on persist/load (see the artifact pin for the attribution), or a gate misclassification of the (Some,Some same-pin) arm -> report-and-stop.

NO-STORM BAND (zero 400/503 by construction — same-boundary retention is deterministic): 2 = T1 + T2 clean; 3 = one retry observed (record the branch — on a pinned row any retry is already a classification-drift signal, adjudicate from the resp bodies); >3 = fallback loop or storm -> report-and-stop; <2 = a turn never fired -> report-and-stop.

FINAL ACCEPTED: the FINAL sol request reached 200. A non-200 final on a pinned same-model resume = BRICK/unclassified wire-error shape -> report-and-stop with the verbatim body (house rule: a new shape is a finding, not a retry).

artifact.label: D1 MINT DISK ROUND-TRIP: the persisted history carries the store-side mint_tag stamp (the (Some,Some) Retain arm's precondition). Absent = the stamp was lost on persist or on the resume load — the wire pin's failure, if any, is then attributable to the persistence seam, not the gate.
